findings: Owner request 2026-11-09: practice short questions for Chapter 2 in the same format as the Physics chapter practice, long questions in the Computer Science Board shape (8 marks each) (English and Roman Urdu), written from the chapter; not printed in the book. 79 questions numbered 1-79; by section: 2.1 5, 2.2 9, 2.3 9, 2.4 10, 2.5 10, 2.6 11, 2.7 5, 2.8 8, 2.9 8, 2.10 4.

Covers every section in book order; every "difference" answer is a two-column table; answers are 2-4 lines or a short program with its output. None repeats the chapter exercise (purpose of comments, int vs float, precedence definition, short-hand vs regular if-else, range() in a for loop, default parameters, why modular programming, class vs object are left to the exercise). All programs were run in Python 3 and the outputs shown are their real outputs. Book corrections followed (BMI = weight / height ** 2, lower-case if and import, no hyphen in a function name, remove() needs the exact item).
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
